# Security policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please report security problems privately, not in a public issue:

1. Go to the [Security tab](https://github.com/QuantumBoy-729/ThunderBirdX/security)
   of this repository.
2. Choose **Report a vulnerability** and describe the problem and how to
   reproduce it.

## What to report here

- Problems in ThunderBirdX's own code: its interface, settings, branding or
  release builds.
- Anything that looks like it comes from Thunderbird or Firefox itself (the
  mail, network and rendering engines). Report it here too if you're not
  sure; it will be passed on to Mozilla when it isn't specific to ThunderBirdX.

Vulnerabilities in Thunderbird can also be reported straight to Mozilla
through their [security bug bounty program](https://www.mozilla.org/security/bug-bounty/).

## Supported versions

Only the latest ThunderBirdX release gets fixes. ThunderBirdX picks up
Thunderbird's security fixes through the weekly upstream merge, so update to
the newest release to get them.
